name: python-gitignore-matcher
title: Ignore Matcher
blurb: Read an ignore file the way git reads it: anchored versus bare patterns, directory-only rules, the last matching rule winning, and the ancestor rule that makes a negation useless.
default_description: Decide whether a path is ignored, and say which line decided it, with the anchoring and ancestor rules made explicit.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
